summary: B1 revised Explore review completed with changes-requested. The new object-contract matrix resolves B1-RE-004 and gives Proposal-ready ownership and field-level guidance. One blocking state-contract regression was introduced: RunStatus adds in-progress, although the frozen core model and B1 implementation reference define the Run state set as pending, completed, failed, cancelled only. The separate ActionResult execution status may express in-progress; RunStatus may not.

blockingFindings.title: RunStatus introduces an unfrozen in-progress state
blockingFindings.evidence: The new object matrix defines RunStatus as pending | in-progress | completed | failed | cancelled. The frozen core model documents the complete Run status set as pending, completed, failed, cancelled; the B1 implementation reference repeats the same set. The matrix's own ActionResult ExecutionStatus separately contains in-progress, so the execution-progress concept does not require expanding RunStatus.
blockingFindings.impact: A Run with status in-progress would pass B1's proposed schema validator but violate the frozen lifecycle contract. It also creates an unapproved additional Run state that later persistence and Policy code could treat inconsistently.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Remove in-progress from RunStatus and add an explicit acceptance/test expectation that the schema rejects it as an unknown Run state. Retain in-progress only on ActionResult.ExecutionStatus if needed to describe an execution result; do not add a Run transition or persistence behavior for it. Recheck the Explore for any other statement that expands the frozen Run state set.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Section 5.1 now covers all eleven objects with ownership, minimum fields, and validation expectations while retaining C1's physical serialization and adapter boundary.
